name: Dr. Ru Shan Shy
headline: ZSA Educator · Clinical Practice · Neuroscience-Informed Teaching
summary: International educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture with long-term clinical learning under Professor Ming Qing Zhu and advanced neuroscience training in Taiwan.
bio: Dr. Ru Shan Shy is a direct disciple of Professor Ming Qing Zhu and an international educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture. Her academic and clinical training includes medicine at China Medical University, graduate study at National Taiwan University, and advanced doctoral-level neuroscience training at the Institute of Neuroscience, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan. Her teaching integrates classical Chinese medicine, clinical observation, functional reassessment and neuroscience-informed reasoning.

name: Dr. Sheng Chun Chang
headline: ZSA Educator · Clinical Practice · Pharmacy, Neuroscience & Chinese Medicine
summary: International ZSA educator with multidisciplinary training across Pharmacy, Neuroscience and Chinese Medicine.
bio: Dr. Sheng Chun Chang is a direct disciple of Professor Ming Qing Zhu and an international educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture. His multidisciplinary background spans Pharmacy, Neuroscience and Chinese Medicine. His teaching connects classical ZSA theory with biomedical, pharmacological and neurophysiological perspectives while maintaining a strong emphasis on clinical assessment, technique and functional response.
